verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's own pricing docs confirm a drag-and-drop email editor and basic email templates, so the visual-editor and template parts of the story are covered. Personalization is mentioned only as general data-driven marketing, with no documented merge tags or tokens, and nothing covers on-brand styling or rendering across email clients. Missing for 10: documented personalization tokens/merge tags, cross-client rendering or preview testing, brand controls (saved styles/brand kit), detail on template reuse, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Basic email templates and drag-and-drop editor
email marketing that uses real-time data and AI to power personalization
